opportunities.name: NPS park lookup by state
opportunities.description: Find a National Park Service unit by US state and open one of its sub-pages (e.g. conditions, basic info, heritage area) by reading the state's park list.
steps: Click the link for the target state
Click the target park, heritage area or site in the state's list
Click the section link to open (e.g. 'Current Conditions', 'Basic Information')
parameters: park or site name in the state list

instances.values: state=Alaska; site='1 National Heritage Area' then 'Kenai Mountains-Turnagain Arm National Heritage Area'

opportunities.description: Look up the live status of a Megabus trip by entering its service number (optionally choosing a stop/city) via the Check my bus flow.
steps: Type the service number into 'Search by Service Number'

Click 'Find my bus' (or submit the search)

opportunities.name: Resy event or happy-hour ticket reservation
opportunities.description: Book a ticketed Resy event or reservation at a venue by choosing the event, the party or ticket count, the time slot, and confirming with Reserve Now.
steps: Open resy.com and choose the city (or search the venue/restaurant name in the search box)
Click 'View all' for the city/venue results and open the target listing
Open the target event or venue listing
Set the ticket or party-size dropdown to the desired count
Pick the time slot or ticket option (e.g. 'Book Now' for a ticket tier)
